# XARElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasXARElement` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/Plugins/Vector/XAR/UltraCanvasXARPlugin.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/Plugins/Vector/XAR/UltraCanvasXARPlugin.h) · `#include "Vector/XAR/UltraCanvasXARPlugin.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasXARExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasXARExamples.md)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasXARElement(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPageChanged` | `std::function<void(int)> onPageChanged` | Fired after SetCurrentPage changes the shown page |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### enum `XARTransparencyType`

Note: avoid the identifier `None` here — X11's headers define `None` as a macro (0L) which would mangle the enumerator name on Linux builds.

### enum `XARWindingRule`

How a path's subpaths combine. Xara fills by the even-odd (alternate) rule, so that is the default here — a path that never carries a TAG_WINDINGRULE record still fills the way Xara draws it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `EvenOdd` |  |
| `NonZero` |  |
